Game Overview

In Temple of Oom, the core idea is straightforward: navigate the vibrant labyrinth of Temple of Oom, aiding the endearing Oomee in his quest for fruit. Strategically move blocks to forge an unobstructed path, facing increasingly complex puzzles that challenge your logic and creativity, all wrapped in delightful graphics and intuitive controls.

How to Play

Temple of Oom keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Navigate the vibrant labyrinth of Temple of Oom, aiding the endearing Oomee in his quest for fruit. Strategically move blocks to forge an unobstructed path, facing increasingly complex puzzles that challenge your logic and creativity, all wrapped in delightful graphics and intuitive controls.
